name: Lab — Java Lambda + API Gateway (WDL-1/WDL-2 fixture)
description: Hand-authored CALM gold for the java-lambda-apigw lab package. Exercises WDL-1 (Lambda RequestHandler -> service unit, CFN path join across two files) and WDL-2 (a handler that owns its own DynamoDbClient must still be typed service, not database, once http-entry-point evidence exists). Authored from Serverless_HTTP_and_Dynamo_Ownership_Design.md and the fixture source directly, never from generator output.

metadata.value: specified-unbuilt until B-lambda-http (Y3-Y4) and B-dynamo-handler-kind (Y2) ship — see standing exam E-fidelity-lambda-lab

nodes.name: TierService
nodes.description: Lambda handler (implements RequestHandler), no Dynamo import of its own — delegates to TierStore. WDL-1 clean positive case.

nodes.name: LegacyTierHandler
nodes.description: Lambda handler that ALSO owns its own DynamoDbClient field directly. Must stay `service`, not `database`, once http-entry-point evidence exists — this is the exact WDL-2 disconfirming case (real counterpart: aws-saas-boost-tier-service HT-ASB-002).

nodes.name: TierStore
nodes.description: Real DynamoDB store — constructs and owns DynamoDbClient as its own field.

nodes.name: java-lambda-apigw system
nodes.description: Composite boundary for this lab package's architectural units.

relationships.description: TierService delegates to TierStore for all Dynamo access.
Lab system composed of the two handlers and the store.
